title: nan
authors: Deng H.; Li D.; Shen B.; Zhao Z.; Arif U.
key_contribution: Presents an absolute velocity estimation method for UAVs using Fourier-based image phase correlation fused with monocular vision, IMU, and sonar via Kalman filtering in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
